{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Oldevai Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 12 [[R-41 Starchaser]]s used by the [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]].

==History==
When the Rneekii pirates managed to [[Ambush on Hashim|kidnap]] the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|Chief]] [[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] project. They decided to [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] him to the highest bidder, which became the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Rneekii arranged the deal near the [[Planet/Legends|Planet]] [[Kiilimaar]].

The deal proceeded with 5 of the fighters escorting the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] ''[[Ibutho 1]]'' carrying the scientist, while one [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] would escort the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda Shuttle]] carrying the ransom. Unfortunately, they underestimated the resolve the Empire was willing to take to recover the scientist, the gunboat was piloted by the best ace [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] who upon receiving the signal "Full Speed to Kiilimaar" [[Battle of Kiilimaar|turned]] againt the pirates and the Imperials sent the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] [[Red Claw]] to trap the pirates. Despite the rest of the squadron being launched from their [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike Cruiser]] ''[[Ayenzii]]'' the Squadron was eliminated by Stele, along with their cruiser and their transport carrying the ransom was captured.
